R for Data Science is one of the most popular introductions to data science in R. The second edition covers the whole data science workflow:

* Importing data from files, spreadsheets, databases and the web
* Tidying and transforming data with the tidyverse
* Visualising data with ggplot2
* Writing functions and iterating
* Communicating results with Quarto

Although it is not specific to healthcare, the skills it teaches apply directly to day-to-day work in health and care analytics.

You can read the book for free at <https://r4ds.hadley.nz>.
